body:
I took 600mg Desoxypipradrol, 220mg Alpha Methyl Tryptamine, as well as 300mg phenazepam, combined over a 36 hour sitting.
I started to play a band rehearsal, jammed with the bassist for a couple of hours, and after they realised I was off my tit the band left. I had been doing 6-ADP for a few days prior and started to drink again. I spent all night with this girl and her friend but she didn't want to see me after I drunkenly informed her I had been sectioned. I had not played the drums for months and decided to play on by myself doing a sort of phil collins / jojomayer mixture. It was great. I played until 5 the next day so totalling about 27 hours. That was when I started hallucinating. I was seeing little things developing on the snare drum. Firstly the drum head started to consume itself, turning into little white powder people. Then a miniature race of tiny human beings, so small I could only assume that was what they were began to appear. They were created by me pulling the little black stick marks away from the drumhead using my eyes, becoming 3D and starting to move around the drum.
I packed up the snare and a cymbal too and took them home to continue to observe this race. I seemed to be creating the powder men with my eyes. I could influence there movements to start off with. I remember talking to them. They asked me to put some 5 MeO DALT on the drum for them. I did. Then to my horror the human or black tiny beings began to die off. Perhaps they were slaves to the white powder men. Perhaps not. They had been only alive for one day as far as I was aware I had created them. Then the white powder men started to turn into a large insect. It was weird. I couldn't communicate with them properly anymore but they claimed to be doing good, before turing into an insect and flying off, disappearing into the wall.
I then started to have the ability to warp physical objects with my mind. I decided to try to prove this to myself and drew a circle on the cymbal, with a view to warping it. It was a difficult task with the circle because the light was trapped by the circle so I did not achieve this, and it was based on harnessing light or radiation as far as I was aware.
I went outside onto the balcony and got to work on the tree. I in my mind had expanded it to about twice the size, as it I were forcing it to grow really fast. I went back indoors. I put some drum and bass on and spoke to my ex on msn, after looking at a photo of her in which her eyes moved, asked her for some naked pictures or to chat on webcam, and was given a false skype address and eventually started to halloucinate a whole new computer operating system.
At night, I then decided to go for a walk and left the dnb on, went outside and there were people in the hedgerows. Loads of them. On my trip I kept offering out 2-DPMP and eventually I got back to my flat after some time talking to people in the hedgerows. I had gained the ability to communicate with them telepathically however I could not stop myself using words and speaking. Maybe they were just a quiet bunch of people. They were plant mermaids, half plant, half human, and they were actually offering me there arms. I pulled the arms off and assumed it was meant to be smoked. I got a whole carrier bag of the stuff. This is one of the only things that survived the trip, and does not resemble the plant matter from the same place in the hedge. I smoked some of it later that week. It seemed to do nothing. As I took the mermaid arms they grew back. However I was scared I would turn into a plant person so I have not smoked any more.
During the trip people came and went from my flat. There were some people in one of my posters which had a black background. They seemed to like Yngvie J Malmsteen's Concerto suite for electric guitar and orchestra in E flat minor, saying 'that is some sweet music'. I tried to get some drugs off them. They ended up not being able to sort me out as they were trapped in the poster and not able to let me into what appeared to be a small room, despite offering me something through the poster I could not get it as I was not able to connect with that room. I got given some black stuff, maybe 40mg in a glass by some of the people in the flat. They could move the glass and change the music so I assume they were real. I took it. They did not tell me what it was. I could not get a response to how long does it last besides a sort of re assurance that it was good.
I was still able to enlarge objects with my eyes and tried to enlarge my cock. It was successful at the time but went back to normal even while I was still tripping. It was weird and embarrassing but worth a shot. I then went to bed for a ten minute lie down of something as I had been up a few days. I was confronted by a nearly invisible ex girlfreind, whom I told I loved, which she did not reciprocate, I then started to have a bad trip, I later had the 2-DPMP stolen and shouted 'can I have my drugs back please' out the window. It was some time before a smaller amour of 2-DPMP appeared at the bottom of the stairs leading up to the flat on a miniature robot. I decided after a while that this robot was dangerous. A second robot appeared. I later smashed the robots with a hammer obtained from my fathers shed and retrieved the drugs.
I took some 2-DPMP and maybe a bit of phenazepam. Phenazepam was not something I wanted to do but given the usually lethal doses of stimulants I thought it sensible, however 300mg is a LOT of phenazepam. Equivalent to 600mg Lorazepam or 6000mg diazepam, which would usually be lethal, and should be responsible for the elevated tranvases (liver enzymes) that showed up on the blood test taken on my next admission to hospital, as the drugs are all metabolised by the liver. Phenazepam has a half life of 50 hours whereas desoxypipradrol has a half life of about 20 hours, meaning that the stimulation lasted less than the sedation, eventually I decided that because I had taken roughly double the amount of desoxypipradrol, which is proportionally half the strength of the phenazepam, I had actually struck a good balanced dose of the drugs, even though I was not thinking about it much, influenced more my feelings than what was scientifically the correct dose. I then started to see strange novelty military appearing and some of the people in the hedgerows started to turn hostile towards me to a degree, however this was partially paranoia. I had to defeat the small military in the garden. I thought they were going to take over! I kicked one bloke about a foot high over who had started to come towards me with an armed miniature bazooka. He started to come back and I decided to seek help from the people staying in my parents house next door, after knocking on the door I started to bang on the door loudly with some object I found that would wake them. I told them to call the military or something and then looked back into the garden. The miniature fighters had gone. Damn. I had just alerted people who had no psychedelic experience or hallucinations or madness before like this and would not be able to relate to my trip. I was later admitted to hospital, going in and out of random trips, sober one minute, tripping the next.
I had a reasonably lucid conversation with a psychiatrist and took the opportunity to enlarge the text on a lion bar which was given to me. The people from my house said ' yes i see, it has got bigger' although i had far less power at achieving this by this stage and even I thought the enlargement was only small. My computer was taken away from me dispute the fact I had carried it all the way to the hospital and was supposedly 'going to the hospital to get some sleep'. Eventually I was sectioned and injected with haloperidol and lorazepam which was not the correct choice of meeds because I was on aripiprazole, which is known to interact badly with dopamine antagonists rarely but more importantly was an awful combo with the drugs I had taken already. I began to run around naked because of some scary shit. There were people with guns outside my window, however I kept walking past them and the staff assured me nobody was there. I was put into a bedroom with people outside the window. I thought shit man I must sleep under the bed not in it I will be a bit safer then. So I did. Eventually. The second scariest trip of my life. I do not believe that my trip would have been as bad as this but I had decided to start tapering myself off the aripiprazole which caused psychotic symptoms and I forgot to take it for days while on all those drugs.
To sum up, considering the doses I did pretty well!
